description: Adds email authentication and tracking DNS records for your Assistfinity sending domain.
variableDescription: %dkim_selector%: DKIM selector label without ._domainkey. %dkim_data%: full DKIM TXT value for that selector. %mail_prefix%: envelope or tracking host label under the sending host. %track_to%: tracking CNAME target. %env_to%: envelope CNAME target. %dmarc_to%: DMARC CNAME target.
